decisions.because: Counterexample (hunt 2026-10-10): parse accepted node=+1, records=0003 and upper-case hex, which statement never writes, and a file named for another statement than it holds was confirmed or skipped. Fix: only the canonical line parses; a file not named after its statement is malformed.

statement: (ADR-0022, opt-in) A head statement is one exact line, written durably once and never rewritten; the node contacts nothing. `--verify-anchors` checks the log against every statement for this node; a file named like a statement that is not one fails the check.
